name: Art Deco Waterfront Apartment - 1 bedroom
description:
The space
This lovely old ground floor apartment is in the heart of Williamstown at the ‘Paris’ end of Ferguson St, within metres of yachts, shops, & restaurants. The Apartment includes a complimentary breakfast basket provided upon arrival. Theres a fireplace in the living room and the apartment is modern yet maintains its Art Deco heritage.

Guest access
Guests can use our exclusive discounts with trusted restaurants and shops in the area. Guests need to check in across the road at the Captains Retreat B&B, where they will be given their keys and complimentary breakfast basket.
neighborhood_overview: Williamstown is an historic seaport situated on a small peninsula with delightful views of the city and Port Phillip Bay.
host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

host_about:
I was born in Melbourne, and know the attraction of Melbourne is very much about its lifestyle. While it’s still got its “Hustle & Bustle” the magic about Melbourne is how it balances this hectic activity with the arts, sports and entertaining. Melbournian’s have passion for living life and that’s a major element towards Melbourne being voted as one of the world’s most liveable and friendliest cities (EIU's Global Liveability Ranking)

I have spent most of my life on the Mornington Peninsula (one hour south of Melbourne). I work in Melbourne’s CBD and have now also moved into the city to live. I’m an avid traveler, but with so many destinations still explore both in Australia and overseas. 
My greatest memories of traveling are often the people you meet and the experiences that are not found on the main tourist trail. I always love talking to a local character getting that special place to visit or café to dine (usually a cousin’s cafe). 
I have now come to a stage in my life I’d like to share some of Melbourne’s special places with others. These are not only my places of interest but also those hidden secrets that previous guests have found and have been excited to share with us.

I like to think “Abode 316 & 317” are special!  They are less than a year old and designed to be functional, yet have a touch of sophistication. They are fully optioned for the traveler and create that home away from home a hotel just can’t offer. 
Accommodation can often make or break a holiday, but I know the accommodation and hospitality my apartments will add to your Melbourne experience.
Rob

host_about:
We are a nurse (Angus) and a Human Resource professional (Lana) and we LOVE to travel, spend time with friends, cycle, crochet and read. Although Angus wanted to make sure that it's me that likes crocheting! 

The five things I can't live without are: chocolate, coffee, animals (specifically my sausage dog Coco and our giant cat called Ted), friends and family!

AS A TRAVELLER(Lana)
In 2013 I went to France, Italy, Serbia, Croatia and Vietnam with a friend where we backpacked and AirBnB'd around, went to a music festival and hired a car to drive around.
In 2014 I went to New York on my own for a couple of weeks for a music festival, stayed at a hostel.
In 2015, I took my parents on a 5 week European extravaganza through France, Italy and Greece. We hired a car and took our time meandering through and staying exclusively w AirBnB. 
In 2016, I think I stayed in Australia, but... I met Angus!
2017 was action packed, we went to NZ to be the 'best lady' army friends wedding. 
In 2017 I went to Italy, Montenegro and Serbia for my 35th birthday celebrations. I travelled with my two friends and Angus. Staying at AirBnB places of course! 

Style: I treat others as I like to be treated, and that includes belongings and their properties. I am respectful and if I'm going to be partying, it will be outside! I am an extroverted, social person who loves getting out and about.

AS A HOST
I joined AirBnB as a host in July 2015 when I was travelling around and not at home for lengthy periods. So I put up my one bedroom apartment up on Airbnb which gave me a piece of mind to ensure that someone will be in there and I absolutely love my apartment and want everyone else to as well!

Since then, in early 2019 we bought our townhouse in Abbotsford. It needed some TLC so we spent a few months (read: every spare waking moment) renovating on our home ready for us to move in. However we're house sitting until November in Moonee Ponds which is about 8km from our new home.

We have spent a lot of time renovating it but you will find me constantly shuffling things around. I am definitely a home body when I'm at home and love being surrounded by pretty, tidy clean areas. 

I like to think about what things are important to me when I am looking at places on AirBnB and make sure I have those ready!

Favourite Destination: Italy 
Book: The Girl with all the Gifts, The Time Traveller's Wife
Movies: Some Like it Hot, Ace Ventura, Crazy Stupid Love
Music: Anything I can dance to!
Food: Anything sweet, or salty, or crunchy, or sour.... okay, everything!

Motto: it is what it is.

neighborhood_overview:
Why South Melbourne is one of the city’s true gems
ERIN MUNRO JAN 16, 2018

Once known as Emerald Hill, it wouldn’t be a stretch to call South Melbourne one of the city’s gems. Characterised by heritage streetscapes with Victorian terraces and a village feel, it sits just two kilometres south of the CBD, has a beach nearby and a thriving food scene.

There’s also the suburb’s beating heart: the South Melbourne Market. Established in 1867, the red brick building bordered by cafes and fruit stalls has long been a go-to for locals and tourists alike.


“I just love the atmosphere, there’s always something happening,” says Agathe Kerr, originally from France and now one of the market’s traders. Her stall, Agathe Patisserie, has been a fixture of South Melbourne Market for 2½ years, with shoppers patiently enduring long queues for a chance to buy one of her croissants.

The heart of the suburb: the South Melbourne Market. Photo: Josh Robe

neighborhood_overview:
Prahran (also known colloquially as "Pran") is an inner suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia, 5 km south-east of Melbourne's Central Business District. Prahran is a part of Greater Melbourne, with many shops, restaurants and cafes.

The shopping street Chapel Street is a mix of upscale fashion boutiques and cafes. Greville Street, once the centre of the Melbourne's hippie community, has many cafés, bars, restaurants, bookstores, clothing shops and music stores.

Prahran takes its name from Pur-ra-ran, a compound of two Aboriginal words, meaning "land partially surrounded by water".

Prahran is home to a large collection of architecturally significant commercial buildings, with many on the Victorian Heritage Register.

The former Greville Botanical Gardens, now "Grattan Gardens", are off Greville Street, on Grattan Street.

Enjoy specially selected vintage and contemporary accessories/artworks styled together with high-quality furnishings and supportive beds plus fully equipped kitchens.  Also, a generous array of high-quality essentials is thoughtfully provided for you to use & enjoy during your stay.

This delightful character is priceless and just cannot be replicated.

East Brunswick House, as the name suggests, is located in the bustling inner northern Melbourne suburb of East Brunswick. Located only 4kms, from Melbourne's CBD, East Brunswick offers a unique charm and urban context.

With edgy Brunswick to the west, refined Carlton North to the south and hip Fitzroy & Collingwood to the east, East Brunswick is perfectly positioned to allow you to explore all that surrounds it. Plus, being located along some of Melbourne's best public transport routes, you have access to a quick and reliable way to explore Melbourne's charm further afield.

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

Bronnie and Neil

Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

host_about:

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

neighborhood_overview:
Our property is enroute to Mt Donna Buang and the Aquaduct Trail. It is very private and quiet, located down a long driveway, and hidden away from the main road. We have beautiful views of the mountains and it is a perfect take off point for cycling, hiking or walking.
For cyclists, it is the perfect jump off point to tackle Mt Donna Buang. The Warburton Water Park is nearby. Stroll into town along the riverside walk and see the fairy houses carved into the trees along the way. Or you can tube into town on the river from the take off point at the nearby bridge.
For those seeking an even more restorative experience, the Diamond Light Healing and Workshop Centre is just 100 metres away from our property. Book in advance directly with the centre for massages etc.
We respect our neighbours' peace and privacy and ask that you do too. We do not tolerate loud music or rowdy behaviour from guests.
host_about:
After 20 years living in three very different large cities in north east Asia, I returned to Australia seeking somewhere beautiful to live. Our cottage in Warburton is just that: set on five acres of landscaped gardens, and providing privacy and peace.
Just 80 metres from the O’Shaunnessy  Aquaduct Trail, and on the incline to  Mt Donna Buang , the cottage offers a cosy and quiet retreat after a day out enjoying all that Warburton has to offer.
Our property is a mix of manicured gardens, glorious exotic plants, our own forest and secret garden hideaways which provide a wonderland for children and adults alike. 
It is a little slice of heaven in this beautiful part of the world.

neighborhood_overview: Williamstown is an historic seaport situated on a small peninsula with delightful views of the city and Port Phillip Bay.
host_about:
We proudly offer you a boutique selection of Rooms, Suites, Apartments and Cottages (many with water views) in beautiful, historic, Williamstown.

Rooms & Suites
Our lovely old home is just one door from the water, boat marina and restaurants and has been tastefully renovated and decorated so that every room has ensuites (some with spas) and most of the rooms also have gas log fires. One of the rooms has its own private lounge and balcony but other guests can enjoy the shared lounge room with fire and bay window.  

Apartments & Cottages
The apartments and cottages that we offer are dotted around Williamstown and most are an easy walk to the restaurants, yacht-clubs and shops. They vary from 1-4 bedrooms and 1-3 bathrooms. (One apartment even has a 4th toilet). 

We are not just offering a spare room in our house. This is our business and we are a dedicated team working to ensure that your stay is comfortable.  We are very careful about the apartments and cottages that we choose to take on and have refused many from owners wanting us to manage them.

Having said that, Williamstown is the oldest suburb in Melbourne and therefore some of the classic older apartments have décor such as shower over the bath. Whilst I would normally say no to venues like this, there are two apartments that have this but their other qualities so far outweigh that one negative and I quietly chip away at the owners in order for that to be changed.  I mention this because we want you to let us know if you have mobility issues so that we can suggest other venues for you. 

Other than beds (which are purchased to order and very comfortable!!), I love to buy antique and pre-loved furniture to fit certain venues and I have them restored using classic and sometimes quirky fabrics so you will not find a ‘hotel’ feel to our venues. Each one is quite different (some are Modern, some Victorian and some are Art-deco era). 

Re Dining: 

Breakfast: We provide a breakfast basket to guests staying in the apartments and cottages. Sadly due to restrictions related to covid, we do not currently offer breakfast in the main house so have reduced prices accordingly and our house-guests enjoy very good breakfasts in one of our many local cafes / restaurants, all within 2-4 minutes of here. (There are three places that we particularly recommend for a great breakfast).   There is however a table set in the bay window and you are welcome to use (Email hidden by Airbnb) plementary Tea, coffee and biscuits are provided in all venues. 

Dinner: There is an excellent choice of restaurants with a variety of cuisines all within walking distance to nearly all of the venues that we offer. 

I'm proud to say that we have won the last 7 awards for 'tourism' and/or 'hospitality' at the Hobsons Bay region Business excellence awards as well as taken out the People's Choice award for the state of Victoria twice in the last three awards. 

Most of our guests are businesspeople or travellers so you can be assured of a quiet, relaxing and private 'home award from home' experience. We want your accommodation to be comfortable and check-ins and check-outs easy so that you can get on with enjoying the reason that you are here.

We look forward to welcoming you to beautiful Williamstown. 

Best regards, 

Melissa and the team from Captains Retreat

Just up the road is Golden Square Bicentennial Park that has a big oval, playground and the 'Fairy tree' which is pretty cute. Just next to the park is 'Serotonin Cafe' which has amazing food and coffee. Just under the railway there's 'Friends of Mine' cafe and 'Jethros' cafe which are both excellent too. A bit more of a walk and you're right in the thick of things of Swan St and Church St Richmond which have endless choices of great eating and drinking establishments.
Go for a 5km walk or ride to Federation Square in the city centre. You are welcome to borrow a bike and ride the Yarra City bike trail that will lead you to the Arts Centre, Southbank, Albert Park or St Kilda Beach.
Burnley also has easy access to the M1 freeway which means it's just 30 mins from the airport as well as easily accessible to drive to other great Victoria destinations

neighborhood_overview:
Port Melbourne is located in inner city bayside Melbourne. It has the enviable reputation of being one of Australia’s most desirable and hip places to live. The area is currently undergoing intense urban renewal with fancy high-rise apartments, cool converted warehouses many renovated and restyled weatherboard cottages. It has a wide mix of architecture.

Port Melbourne’s heritage is as a port and industrial area. Port Melbourne with its heavy drinking wharfie past had a reputation for having a pub on almost every corner. YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and meet and host wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

host_about:
(Click on my logo above to see more than 20 other StayCentral listings).

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I also love short domestic trips for weekends away just to relax. 

It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

Emerald-Cockatoo recreational trail is ideal for walkers and cyclists and offers access to a range of family fun and recreational activities.

host_about:
(Click on my logo above to see more than 20 other StayCentral listings).

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I also love short domestic trips for weekends away just to relax. 

It means I get to be on the other side of the counter, and experience how other people look after their guests: and I take their good ideas back with me. 

I even worked as a part-time tourist guide in Melbourne for a couple of years when I arrived here, and really enjoyed the interactions with the tourists off the huge cruise liners that appear in Melbourne each spring and summer. I have tried to extend this experience into my accommodation business here in Melbourne, where I really love assisting people with their stays. You only need to read some of the 1,000 plus reviews on Airbnb, Trip Advisor, Goo gle, and on my own StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments website to realise how much our guests enjoy our apartments, and the way we look after them. 

I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

I do hope I have the opportunity to help you get to know Melbourne and grow to love it as I have. If you have any questions about StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments, please feel free to call me on (Phone number hidden by Airbnb) during business hours, and I will do my best to help you.

name: Moira Carriagehouse - roam or relax!
description:
Moira Carriagehouse is our quirky garage reno. Rustic, yet stylish, you have private entry, double bed, heating, en suite and your own courtyard. The Carriagehouse is separate from our home. The peaceful space has views of the horse paddock with visits from parrots, kookaburras and other birds. Perfect for escaping the city, a base for a Yarra Valley event, visiting wineries or to just sit and chill. The Carriagehouse offers the perfect opportunity to roam or relax.

The space
Relaxing: The courtyard has your own private space for relaxing. The rest of the backyard may be shared when we are around.
When fire restrictions permit, you can request a fire at additional cost - let us know before 4pm.
We do have chooks. Occasionally they like to roam as well. If you would like them put in their run, please let us know.

Roaming: We are very close to the Healesville Sanctuary and 3.4kms to town. Close to many wineries, gin distilleries, breweries
neighborhood_overview: Healesville is a tourist town with much to offer. The Sanctuary is 2 streets away; wineries a short drive and the fit can even walk into town where there is a great choice of distilleries, wineries, breweries, cafes, galleries and restaurants. The Badger Creek Blueberry winery is around the corner [home of St Ronan's cider], Badger Weir and Maroondah Dam offer great picnic spots and there are walks and hikes to suit all levels of fitness.
host_about: Mary and Adam enjoy the peace and quiet of Moira Cottage and Moira Carriagehouse and have lived here for many years. The backyard birds are a delight. There's nothing better than relaxing after visiting the cafes, wineries and distilleries close by. Having travelled to many parts of the world, there's nothing quite like home. Our philosophy is, "no such thing as a stranger, just a friend you've yet to meet".

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
Since working in a guesthouse in England in the 1970's, I've loved hosting people from around the world - friends, family, students - and airbnb is another great opportunity to share this beautiful part of the world that I call home. 

I am so lucky to live on a 6 acre property, about an hour from Melbourne town and less than 2 kilometres from the little township of emerald, which means when Puffing Billy is running, you can hear the train whistle. Located in gorgeous Beaconsfield Upper, this modern cottage sits at the top of a picturesque five acre property with ample lawn and a fire pit. We have three horses here and often see kangaroos, wombats, rabbits, eagles, parrots, kookaburras and more. Enjoy the views from the deck or make the short drive to Emerald, Cardinia Reservoir, Puffing Billy, the Dandenongs and several great wineries. There's also fantastic food and coffee at the Beaconsfield Upper General Store just down the hill.

The space
We're less than an hour from the Melbourne CBD, but you'll feel like you're world's away. Upon arrival, you can park in the carport attached to the cottage. There's a covered front deck with table and chairs to relax with a drink at sunset. Inside, the kitchen and bathroom are modern and there is a comfy couch and piano. We can also provide wood for the fire pit (restrictions permitting of course).
neighborhood_overview: We're on a quiet street amongst mostly horse properties so it's incredibly peaceful. The town centre is small with a wonderful general store/cafe, bakery, Foodworks and several other shops.  Just around the corner from there are the Pine Grove Hotel and Carlei Wines. There's quite a few great restaurants and cafes nearby in Beaconsfield and Emerald as well. And there are plenty of nature trails just a short drive away.

I extended my stay in summer to travel widely in France. Later years I ventured to Germany Switzerland UK Italy Spain and Turkey. I spent 2 years in Texas for my studies later on. host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard.

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

host_about:
Hi Reader, 
I hope you are well. 

As a note ,  I'm new to this site so Im still learning about its workings. Its a great prospect that I hope to learn much from , hosting, but also look forward to having the opportunity to give back.  
I love living in fitzroy, I grew up here and am sure you will too. 

Just one thing I need to touch on;
... by no means is the house brand spanking new. Its a terrace / cottage thats 150 years young, having undergone some improvents twenty plus years ago , then more recently with gas heating being put in , plus ceiling fans being introduced too.  There's a balance I think of old and new in the house. 
Much like myself ,  It has loads character, furthermore, the house is ready to welcome guests but for you to enjoy its suurounds fully, please understand it too comes with its quirks. 
Its a work in progress , and has a bit of a rustic feel to it too,  but has good bones. In winter when it rains you can hear it pelt down on the tin roof,  While open , nice and airy , some improvements are still needing to be had, but even as is, that wont come at the expense of its guests. Its comfy, clean & hygienic - has a homely feel I hope with each piece having a story. 
Keep in mind-  Being inner city , if doors and windows are left open, a critter may enter - keep this in mind -  fly , spider , mouse., bees , lizards, birds. Yes , with nature around us-  & with neighbors having pets it can attract them and us too. While critters are not pests to everything or everyone - we try to live in harmony with them-Of course if this makes you too queasy this probably is not the right place for you. 

I work hard at making sure each stay is better than the last with upgrades and changes undertaken between stays. 
It's taken me the better part of three years to get it to this standard , I can only imagine that in three more years time , it'll look & feel even nicer. Hosting mostly through other sites - 
For me , home can be about loved ones, sharing moments and creating new memories. It should be a place to relax, take in and enjoy. A place where you are free to be You. I hope you enjoy being here as much as I do - its the people that have stayed here that have helped make it what it is today- that can only improve with the years. I'm learning and noticing something new each day in the house so its overall a pretty exciting place to be in.  Please don't hesitate to reach out , if I can be of any further assistance-  I'll do whatever possible to ensure you get the best from this home wherever I can .  

Lastly & with the busyish life I lead , I still have not had a chance to update both listings accordingly. I promise I will get to it very soon though.  (Im talking about my guide books as well. ). 
As a option : If you wanted to get a better idea about the house itself  -  area included & from my perspective - check out both Guidebooks for Greeves St property . Together they contain more information that I hope you will finduseful, there's more to come. .. please be patient- I hope to create a book for the house that'll make life easier too.  Til then , tho, ...

As per mentioned, I will be / am available anytime for questions and should there be anything on your mind/s that'll help make your stay that extra little bit more enjoyable, you need only let me know. Requests are what I'm talking about too. If not sure.. Ask ..whats the worst thst can happen , I'll always try to find an answer , or solution, -  I love a bit of a challenge ,  - I understand also that by learning more about what my guests are looking for earlier, I can be better equipped to handle and take extra care of their needs too. 
This makes for an overall better place all round. 

Thank you for your time, imput & support.  Much love . X 

Warm regards, 
Greeves Street

host_about:

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. I do love living in Melbourne. It enjoys a unique place in Australia. It is often described as the cultural, business, shopping and sporting capital of the country. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. I love living in an urban village amongst these, and all the other everyday shops; and jumping on a tram and avoiding the hassles of traffic. It is a city of great opportunity, experiences, events and lifestyle that can be enjoyed by locals and visitors alike; and I really enjoy facilitating our guests' stays here.

name: Peaceful 8 acre nature retreat
description:
Welcome to our piece of paradise! Our house stands on a one acre sloping field of grass surrounded by seven acres of towering gum and palm trees. The garden is a bird paradise, wallabies and wombats visit regularly, with only one neighbour in the distance.

Our house is surrounded by a covered verandah on three sides to enjoy the nature. The house has four bedrooms with garden views, two bathrooms, two living rooms, which comfortably fit eight people (ten on request).

The space
Our house is located on an 8 acre piece of native bushland. It is ringed by a towering forest and feels private and secluded, you just see a neighbouring house in the distance through the trees 100 metres away. At night the house is absolutely quiet, in the morning you might be awoken by the tweeting of birds or the laugh of a Kookaburra.

The house is luxuriously decorated with a contemporary feel, and quirky artwork throughout. But the real reason to come is nature,
neighborhood_overview:
The house is situated in the Dandenong ranges in a peaceful, lush valley. At the same time, it's only 2 minutes drive to the village Kallista, which has a small supermarket, and a few cafes and restaurants. It's five minutes drive to Olinda and Sassafras, two tourist-favorite mountain villages, and it's less than 10 minutes from Belgrave, with a large supermarket and all the amenities you might want.

There's a lot of amazing hiking around, and we are happy to share tips and tricks. For instance, Grant on Sherbrooke is two minutes drive from our home, and it is a protected nesting ground for lyrebirds with beautiful rainforest hikes.
host_about:
My husband an I are originally from the Netherlands and moved to Melbourne, Australia, for work purposes a few years ago. 
We recently bought a house out in the Dandenong ranges and absolutely love it here! Nature and wildlife are stunning, as if we are living in a nature reserve. We are very proud of our house and like to keep it in great condition 

We travel a lot for work and for fun, and in those times like to make our home available to other guests. When we travel we almost exclusively stay in Airbnb’s so we know exactly what makes a stay great and would like to give that experience to our guests as well.

neighborhood_overview:
Brunswick’s reputation is as a hipster hotspot, but there’s a lot more to this vibrant area than just smashed avos and fancy lattes.

A hub of art, culture and fantastic bars, the area also has historically been home to Greek, Italian and Middle Eastern populations, which is evident in Brunswick’s food scene and community spaces.

A true gem of the north, Brunswick is bustling, artistic and lively – the place to be if you want great craft beer, delicious coffee and to see why Melbourne is known for its exceptional art and music scene.
host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike trained as a chef and moved to the UK in his early 20’s to work and travel through Europe. He is a Sensei, 1st Dan black belt and passionate about teaching children the art of Karate. Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

After the turn of the century, the St Kilda foreshore became Melbourne's favoured playground, with electric tram lines linking the suburbs to the seaside amusement rides, ballrooms, cinemas and cafes, and crowds flocked to St Kilda Beach. host_about:
YOUR HOST: GARY COPOLOV 

Hello, my name is Gary and I live in Middle Park, Melbourne. I currently manage sixteen short to long term accommodation properties in Middle Park (6), Albert Park (3), South Melbourne (4), Port Melbourne (1), North Carlton (1), Torquay (1). Middle Park, Albert Park, South Melbourne and Port Melbourne. These are arguably some of Melbourne’s best inner city suburbs. I believe I am fortunate to live and manage properties in the area and meet and host wonderful guests. 

My Airbnb hosting journey started when my wife, Jo and I bought Florence Court in Nimmo Street, Middle Park in 2015. It is a heritage listed, mid 30's Art Deco apartment block in where I now offer four  fantastic short term accommodation apartments. I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.

I started StayCentral Melbourne Corporate Apartments with one apartment, and now manage multiple properties in many different locations in inner Melbourne.

Like many of my guests, I love to travel; both overseas to places like the Mulu Caves in Borneo, ancient cities (in many old countries), Antarctica & Alaska, Patagonia, and colourful markets in amazing places like Pha Long in Vietnam, Jaisalmer in India, Tozeur in Tunisia & La Paz in Bolivia. The restaurants and cafes in Melbourne are amongst the best in the world. host_about:
Hey there you curious creatures! Time to share a little about ourselves. Mike was born and raised in New Zealand and I have a Greek background but am from a small country town in Victoria. Would you believe that in all the time we’ve been together, I haven’t been able to convince Mike to do the HAKA for me? And if you're wondering, the answer is yes...he’s an ex-rugby player and All Blacks man.

Mike is also a qualified landscaper, is now heavily involved in property and is one of those people who’s annoyingly good at everything.

I graduated and practiced as a Podiatrist for a couple of years, before moving into the advertising industry, security risk management and recently a furniture design & importing business. We launched our hosting journey as a way to help others create unforgettable experiences during their travels whilst having the freedom to personally explore more of our amazing world at the same time!

We’re both fans of entrepreneurship, love Gary Vaynerchuck (if you’ve never heard of him, do yourself a favour and look him up) and enjoy studying personal development, online business, the sharing economy and anything that piques our interest at the time. Podcasts, Kindle, books, online courses...we love learning new things.

Thanks for stopping by. We hope the read was worth it and so look forward connecting with you as hosts or as travellers. We will do our best to make your stay truly memorable in all the right ways and also can’t wait to be great guests if we happen to chance by your Airbnb in your little corner of the globe. 

One more thought to take with you wherever you may be...

We Travel Not To Escape Life, But For Life Not To Escape Us.

See you very soon!


Mike & Panagiota x

I now operate sixteen brilliant short to long term accommodation properties in the area ranging from apartments to houses and from one to four bedrooms. They are all stunning and fitted out to the very highest standard. 

As an Airbnb Superhost I offer my guests a concierge like service. I am an unashamed ambassador for the area where I have lived for over 30 years. Just tell me your interests and I will offer my recommendations. 

Each property has a copy of "Adventures" which provides details my recommended local To Do's and the very best of nearby dining pleasures. There are many recommendations for guests of all ages. 

Jo and I met playing tennis at Kooyong Lawn Tennis Club and were married in Paris just over 28 years ago. Jo is a part time teacher at the local primary school where she is a special education reading teacher. She has a real passion for books, real estate and interior design. A typical week will see her at a local café with friends, walking our dog in the nearby park, seeing a movie, attending her book club or a yoga class. 

We have two children. Natasha (Tash) an Architecture - Design graduate working in the construction industry. When she is not out socialising or globetrotting she may occasionally walk our friendly Nova Scotia Duck Tolling Retriever called Hudson. We love pets and welcome them at all properties. 

Our son Louis lives in Portland, Maine, USA where he works for the Boston Celtics basketball team as Player Manager of their second team the Maine Celtics.  He attended university in Boston, USA and represented Australia in rowing as a coxswain. 

On weekends, given a chance, we will visit a beach side holiday apartment with stunning sea views in Torquay. Torquay is just over an hour’s drive from Melbourne. It is Victoria's surf capital and the gateway to the famous Great Ocean Road. In Torquay, we enjoy walks, great local food, wine, the many surf beaches and the company of friends. The apartment is available for stays on Airbnb. (Sleeps 8). 

We have travelled to Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and the USA where we have enjoyed Airbnb hospitality in England, France, Italy, Spain, Bulgaria, Croatia, Turkey, Netherlands, Denmark, Sweden and the United States. I wish to share the same pleasure and the excitement of travel with my guests. 

I am a self-employed Marketing Consultant whose consultancy, Gold Medal Marketing develops and implements winning business development programs for businesses in various industries. I have written and delivered a number of business development programs. 

I am the honorary Chairman of the Australian Patients Association (APA) which advocates, educates and supports Australian patients. The APA strives to be the voice of and for Australian patients. 

I regularly attend a local gym for regular workouts which I would be pleased to introduce to my guests. 

On weekends in Winter I watch St. Kilda, an Australian Rules Football Club as a long standing and sadly long suffering club member.

With a family of designers I am always working on some property development or creative project for myself,  family and friends.

I like to catch a movie or show and visit galleries and believing that you should “be a tourist in your own town” try get out and about to something interesting either near or far. 

I look forward to sharing the great properties which I manage and my local experience with my guests. 

I am available to ensure that you have a great stay. 

Your host, 

Gary Copolov.
